# BorderStyle

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Provides semantic border width presets for common use cases. All values are in points (1/72 inch).

Namespace `BonniePDF`.

## Properties

- [`Hairline`](#hairline): Hairline border - the thinnest practical line (0.25 points).
- [`Heavy`](#heavy): Heavy border (3 points) - very prominent.
- [`Medium`](#medium): Medium border (1.5 points) - slightly emphasized.
- [`None`](#none): No border (width 0).
- [`Normal`](#normal): Normal border (1 point) - standard visible border.
- [`Thick`](#thick): Thick border (2 points) - prominent border.
- [`Thin`](#thin): Thin border (0.5 points) - subtle but visible on most displays.

Hairline border - the thinnest practical line (0.25 points). May not render on all screens but prints well.
